sub.zh: 大卫与歌利亚 · 撒母耳记上 17 章

text.en: A man stops beside you. Dust on his clothes, a scribe's long robe. His name is Corin.
text.zh: 一个人在你身边站住。他满身是土，穿着文士的长袍。他叫柯林。

text.en: “This is the Valley of Elah. About 1020 years before Christ.”
text.zh: 「这里是以拉谷。大约是公元前一〇二〇年。」

text.en: “Remember one thing. We are only witnesses.”
text.zh: 「记住一件事：我们只是见证人。」

text.en: “The ending is God's, not ours. We cannot change it. What we can decide is what kind of people we become.”
text.zh: 「结局是神定的，我们改不了。我们能决定的，是自己要成为什么样的人。」

text.en: Across the valley, the Philistines have been shouting for forty days.
text.zh: 山谷对面，非利士人天天叫阵。已经四十天了。

text.en: Not one man in the Israelite camp has gone out.
text.zh: 以色列这边，没有一个人出去。

text.en: “So. Where will you stand?”
text.zh: 「所以，你要站在哪里？」

text.en: “Walk slowly. When you need me, I will be here.”
text.zh: 「慢慢走。需要我的时候，我就在这里。」

text.en: You came back.
text.zh: 你回来了。

text.en: “We all saw it. The boy went down there without armour on.”
text.zh: 「我们都看见了。那孩子没穿铠甲就下去了。」

text.en: “That thing he said, at the end — did you keep it?”
text.zh: 「他最后说的那句话，你记住了没有？」

text.en: You did.
text.zh: 你记住了。

text.en: He is holding his spear with both hands, head down.
text.zh: 他两手抱着矛，低着头。

text.en: “They say he is three metres tall. All of him is bronze.”
text.zh: 「他们说他有三米高。全身都是铜甲。」

text.en: “His spear shaft is thicker than my arm.”
text.zh: 「他的枪杆，比我的手臂还粗。」

text.en: “I have never been close enough to see him.”
text.zh: 「我从来没走近过，看不清他。」

text.en: “The day I left home, my mother said: do not be afraid.”
text.zh: 「我出门那天，我妈说：不要怕。」

text.en: “Then she cried. She was afraid too. She said it anyway.”
text.zh: 「说完她就哭了。她自己也怕，可她还是说了。」

text.en: “There is a line in the Law. The officers say it to us.”
text.zh: 「律法上有一句话。官长常常对我们说。」

text.en: “And shall say unto them, Hear, O Israel; ye draw near this day unto battle against your enemies.”
text.zh: 「官长又要对百姓说：以色列啊，你今日将要与仇敌争战，」

text.en: “Let not your heart faint; fear not, neither be ye terrified because of them.”
text.zh: 「不要胆怯，不要惧怕他们，也不要惊惶。」

text.en: He puts the words into your hand.
text.zh: 他把这句话交给你。

text.en: “They are not mine to keep.”
text.zh: 「这句话不是我的，你拿着。」

text.en: “Go up if you have to. I will hold this spot.”
text.zh: 「你要上去就上去吧。这里我守着。」

text.en: I went up on the ridge to look. Their tents are still standing. There is nobody in them.
text.zh: 我爬上山脊去看。他们的帐棚还立在那里，里面一个人也没有。

text.en: You were aiming for his forehead. I saw the stone leave your hand, just the once.
text.zh: 你是照着他的额头打的。我看见石头飞过去，就那么一下。

text.en: She is breaking bread. She does not look up.
text.zh: 她在分饼，没有抬头。

text.en: “You are going up too, then. My husband went up. He has not come back down.”
text.zh: 「你也要上去啊。我男人上去了，还没下来。」

text.en: “I do not pray that he wins.”
text.zh: 「我不求他打赢。」

text.en: “I pray he does not lose himself up there.”
text.zh: 「我只求他别把自己丢在上面。」

text.en: “Take this. Bread, and a word with it.”
text.zh: 「拿着。饼，还有一句话。」

text.en: “Bread does not last the day. The word will last longer.”
text.zh: 「饼放不到明天。这句话可以陪你走得远一点。」

text.en: “Eat before you climb. Nobody fights well hungry.”
text.zh: 「上去之前先吃点东西。饿着肚子打不好仗。」

text.en: I had the water boiling for the wounded. The men who came back have no wounds and cannot stand up.
text.zh: 我把水烧上了，等着伤兵回来。回来的人个个没伤，却站不住。

text.en: Someone carried the giant's armour into one of the tents. Nobody will sleep in that tent tonight.
text.zh: 有人把那个巨人的盔甲抬进了一顶帐棚。今晚谁也不肯睡那一顶。

text.en: An old man sits by the road, mending a strap.
text.zh: 一个老人坐在路边，修一条皮带。

text.en: “They will not let you through.”
text.zh: 「他们不会让你过去的。」

text.en: “Even the king says it. You are too young. He has been a fighting man since he was a boy.”
text.zh: 「连王也这么说：你年纪太轻，他从小就打仗。」

text.en: “He is right that you are young.”
text.zh: 「他说你年轻，这没说错。」

text.en: “He is wrong to think young means useless.”
text.zh: 「他错在以为年轻就没有用。」

text.en: “All my life, people have looked at me and decided what I was worth.”
text.zh: 「我这辈子，都在被人打量。」

text.en: He pulls the strap tight.
text.zh: 他把皮带拉紧。

text.en: “Carry one sentence that answers him.”
text.zh: 「带一句能回他的话去。」

text.en: “The stones are at the brook, downstream past the tents. He took five. Not six.”
text.zh: 「石子在下游的溪边，过了帐篷就是。他当时拿了五块。不是六块。」

text.en: Forty days he stood there and shouted at us. I counted every one of them, the way a man counts his own grave.
text.zh: 四十天，他天天站在那里骂我们。我一天一天数，像在数自己的坟。

text.en: They are running them down the road to Gath and Ekron. I am too old to run with them, so I wait here for news.
text.zh: 他们往迦特和以革伦一路追下去了。我老了，跑不动，只能在这儿等消息。

text.en: “Fear not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD.”
text.zh: 「你们不要胆怯，不要惧怕他们，因为耶和华你们的神与你们同去。」

text.en: “Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD.”
text.zh: 「你来攻击我，是靠刀枪和盾牌；我来攻击你，是靠万军之耶和华的名。」

text.en: “Man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.”
text.zh: 「耶和华不像人看人：人是看外貌，耶和华是看内心。」

text.en: “The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.”
text.zh: 「耶和华是我的牧者，我必不致缺乏。」

line.en: “Choose you a man, and let him come down to me!”
line.zh: 「你们拣选一个人，叫他下来到我这里来！他若能与我交战，把我杀了，我们就作你们的仆人。」

tell.en: He shouts loud enough for the whole valley. He wants you to be afraid before you start.
tell.zh: 他喊得整条山谷都听见。他要你先害怕。

line.en: “Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves?”
line.zh: 「我岂是狗呢，你竟拿杖到我这里来？」

tell.en: He is looking at your hands. He wants to know what you are carrying.
tell.zh: 他在看你的手。他想知道你手里有什么。

line.en: “Whose son is this youth? He is but a boy.”
line.zh: 「这少年人是谁的儿子？」他不再对你说话，开始对别人说你。

tell.en: He has stopped talking to you. Now he is talking about you, to everyone else.
tell.zh: 他不跟你说话了。他在跟别人说你。

line.en: “Forty days, and thy God has sent no one. Will he save thee?”
line.zh: 「我今日向以色列人的军队骂阵。你们叫一个人出来，与我交战吧！」

tell.en: This one is quiet. It has been in your head for forty days.
tell.zh: 这一句很轻。可它在你心里已经响了四十天。

triggers.note: crossing north of this row with five stones begins the BECOME

text.en: You reach the line. Your pouch is still empty.
text.zh: 你走到界线前。袋子里还是空的。

text.en: Five stones. The brook is behind you, downstream.
text.zh: 五块石子。溪水就在你身后，下游。

text.en: The line is still in the dust. Your hand still remembers the weight of five stones.
text.zh: 尘土里那条线还在。你的手还记得五块石子的重量。

text.en: You do not have to fight him again. You only have to remember that you stood here.
text.zh: 你不用再打他一次。你只要记得：你曾经站在这里。

text.en: You are a pilgrim. You came into the Valley of Elah with the army of Israel.
text.zh: 你是朝圣者。你跟着以色列的军队，来到以拉谷。

text.en: This battle is not yours. What you can do is walk this valley and listen to its people.
text.zh: 这场仗不是你的。你能做的，是走完这段路，听这里的人说话。

text.en: Keep what they give you. On the day, you will not only watch David. You will be him.
text.zh: 他们交给你的话，你要带上。到了那一天，你不会只是看着大卫。你会成为他。

text.en: Left thumb on the left half: walk. Push further out: run. A, bottom right: talk.
text.zh: 左手拇指按住画面左边：走路。推远一点：跑。右下角的 A：和身边的人说话。

text.en: Tap the screen to turn a page. Lost? Follow the arrow at the top right.
text.zh: 点画面翻页。找不到路，就看右上角的箭头。

stones.en: Gather five smooth stones at the brook
stones.zh: 到下游溪边，替大卫捡五块石子

line.en: Carry the stones north, to the line in the dust
line.zh: 带着石子，走到北边尘土里那条界线

done.en: Chapter complete · the valley is quiet now
done.zh: 本章完成 · 山谷安静了

provision.en: Pick up the three things your father gave you
provision.zh: 把父亲给的三样东西捡起来

brothers.en: Walk to the edge of the camp. Your brothers are there
brothers.zh: 走到营地边上。哥哥们在那里

fight.en: Answer him with what you carry. Then throw.
fight.zh: 用你带着的经文回答他。然后，放手。

npc.en: Walk with Corin. He will bring you to %s.
npc.zh: 跟着柯林走。他带你去找%s。

shepherd.en: A stone in the pouch. Practise on the jars.
shepherd.zh: 皮兜里放一块石子。对着陶罐练手。

saul.en: Listen to the king. Then go.

ready.en: Walk to the line. The whole army is watching.
ready.zh: 走到界线那里。全军都在看着你。

aftermath.en: Corin is waiting to hear it from you.

text.en: The battle is the LORD's.
text.zh: 争战的胜败在乎耶和华。

text.en: The stone was not thrown by your hand. What you learned was this: do not stare at the giant.
text.zh: 石子不是你扔的。可你学会了一件事：不要只盯着眼前的巨人。

text.en: Look at the God who is bigger than he is.
text.zh: 要看那位比巨人更大的神。

text.en: Courage for the giant in front of you comes from looking back at the road God has already walked you through.
text.zh: 回头看神怎么带你走过来，你才有勇气面对眼前的巨人。

text.en: Faith is not sudden. It grows each time you remember.
text.zh: 信心不是突然有的。是一次一次回头看，慢慢坚定的。

ask.en: What giant is standing in front of you now? What would your first step of faith be?
ask.zh: 你生命里，现在有一个什么样的巨人？信心的第一步，你想怎么走？

t.en: Remember the road God has already walked me through
t.zh: 先回想神带我走过的路

insight.en: That is where David started. Not with the giant, but with the lion and the bear behind him. (1 Samuel 17:37)
insight.zh: 大卫就是这样开始的。不是从巨人开始，而是从身后的狮子和熊开始。（撒母耳记上 17:37）

t.en: Say it out loud to someone

insight.en: That is wisdom. Before David went out, he spoke to the men in the ranks. (1 Samuel 17:26)
insight.zh: 这是智慧。大卫出阵以前，也先跟阵上的人说过话。（撒母耳记上 17:26）

t.en: Take off armour that is not mine

insight.en: Saul's armour was good. It was just not David's. Discernment is knowing which help fits you. (1 Samuel 17:39)
insight.zh: 扫罗的盔甲很好，只是不合大卫。分辨力，就是分得清哪些帮助真的适合你。（撒母耳记上 17:39）

text.en: You look down. The hands in front of you are not your hands.
text.zh: 你低下头。眼前这双手，不是你的。

text.en: Three days earlier. Bethlehem.
text.zh: 三天前。伯利恒。

text.en: Your father is at the door with a sack in his hands.
text.zh: 父亲站在门口，手里提着一个袋子。

text.en: “Take these to your brothers. Bread, cheese, and parched grain.”
text.zh: 「把这些东西带去给你哥哥们。饼、奶酪，还有炒好的麦子。」

text.en: “They are with Saul's army, in the Valley of Elah. Ask if they are well.”
text.zh: 「他们跟着扫罗的军队，在以拉谷。去看看他们好不好。」

text.en: Pick up what he gives you. Three things.
text.zh: 把父亲给的东西带上。一共三样。

text.en: Your eldest brother sees you come up the road.
text.zh: 长兄看见你走上坡来。

text.en: 1 Samuel 17:28
text.zh: 撒母耳记上 17:28

text.en: “Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness?”
text.zh: 「你下来做什么？在旷野的那几只羊，你交托了谁呢？」

text.en: “I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.”
text.zh: 「我知道你的骄傲和你心里的恶意；你下来特为要看争战。」

text.en: You say nothing. Someone takes you to the king's tent.
text.zh: 你什么也没说。有人把你带到王的帐棚里。

text.en: Three days earlier. The slope south of Bethlehem.
text.zh: 三天前。伯利恒南边的坡上。

text.en: The sheep graze behind you. The sling in your hand is worn shiny by your palm.
text.zh: 羊在你背后吃草。机弦在你手里，被手心磨得发亮。

text.en: A row of clay jars stands on the slope. You throw at them every day until your arm aches.
text.zh: 坡上立着一排陶罐。你每天对着它们扔石头，扔到手臂发酸。

text.en: This is not war. This is practice.
text.zh: 这不是打仗，是练手。

text.en: The last jar breaks. Someone below the slope is calling your name.
text.zh: 最后一只罐子也碎了。坡下有人喊你的名字。

text.en: Your father wants you at the camp. Your brothers are there.
text.zh: 父亲要你去一趟军营。哥哥们在那边。

text.en: Saul is a head taller than every man in the tent.
text.zh: 扫罗比帐棚里所有人都高出一头。

text.en: 1 Samuel 17:33 — “And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.”
text.zh:
撒母耳记上 17:33
「扫罗对大卫说：你不能去与那非利士人战斗；因为你年纪太轻，他自幼就作战士。」

text.en: “The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.”
text.zh: 「耶和华救我脱离狮子和熊的爪，也必救我脱离这非利士人的手。」

text.en: 1 Samuel 17:37 — “Go, and the LORD be with thee.”
text.zh:
撒母耳记上 17:37
「你可以去吧！耶和华必与你同在。」

text.en: 1 Samuel 17:38 — “And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.”
text.zh:
撒母耳记上 17:38
「扫罗就把自己的战衣给大卫穿上，将铜盔给他戴上，又给他穿上铠甲。」

text.en: It is too heavy. You take two steps and nearly fall.
text.zh: 太重了。你走两步，差点摔倒。

text.en: 1 Samuel 17:39 — “I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them.”
text.zh:
撒母耳记上 17:39
「我穿戴这些不能走，因为素来没有穿惯。」

text.en: You put it off. It was never yours.
text.zh: 你把它脱下来。那从来不是你的。

text.en: Then you walk down the slope, and the whole army watches you go.
text.zh: 然后你往山下走。全军都在看你。

text.en: You fell asleep on the bus home.
text.zh: 你在回家的车上睡着了。

text.en: You wake with the sun straight overhead, and your mouth full of dust.
text.zh: 醒来的时候，太阳正悬在头顶，嘴里全是土。

text.en: Your clothes are not your clothes: coarse wool, a leather cord at the waist.
text.zh: 这身衣服不是你的：粗羊毛，腰上系着一条皮绳。

text.en: Two armies are standing on the hills either side of the valley. Nobody is moving.
text.zh: 山谷两边的山上都站着军队。没有一个人在动。

text.en: Someone behind you is crying quietly. You understand every word.
text.zh: 身后有人压着嗓子在哭。他说的每一个字，你都听得懂。

text.en: The water is shallow and cold. The stones in it are worn round by it.
text.zh: 溪水又浅又凉。底下的石子被水磨得圆了。

text.en: Stones stacked into an altar, and no fire on it. Nobody has had the heart.
text.zh: 几块石头垒成一座坛，上面没有火。没人有这个心气。

text.en: There are axe marks in the trunk. Someone cut wood here, and hid here.
text.zh: 树干上有刀痕。有人在这儿砍过柴，也在这儿躲过。

text.en: A man in a tent is stitching leather. Before a war can be fought, someone has to mend things.
text.zh: 帐棚里有人在缝皮子。仗要打得起来，总得有人先把破的地方补上。
